text:
UDP::release
Description
This iRules command allows client-side ingress to flow following a
call to UDP::hold. Unblocks ingress on client side.
Syntax
UDP
::
release
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
UDP
::
hold
}
when
LB_SELECTED
{
UDP
::
release
}
when
CLIENT_DATA
{
# Load balancing info available
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
LB_SELECTED, SA_PICKED, SERVER_CONNECTED
